items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: I knew Louis, Louis was kind of a nigger if he ever was one. His aunt lived about four doors from me on, on Clavin Avenue.

ctx.x: In fact, Louis Armstrong used to listen to Hardy. Is that so? Yeah. I knew Louis, Louis was kind of a nigger if he ever was one. His aunt lived about four doors from me on, on Clavin Avenue. It was a mixed neighborhood down there. Mrs. Stella Armstrong, she was a midwife. It was back in the days when they had those gals that brought in the babies. And I said, well, Joe Maselli was, I went to school with Joe. And Joe used to idolize. He tried to play Louis and everything else. But Louis was in the waif's home and…
Well, Louis went on to play with a band that seems to have had some influence on you guys and the ailes. Fletcher Henderson? Yeah, yeah. Did you listen a lot to Fletcher Henderson?
